page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn9g.64xlarge is an accelerator-focused bare-metal virtualized instance engineered for massive parallel computing and AI workloads. The instance is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9A75 processors operating at 3.3 GHz across an x86_64 architecture, providing 256 vCPUs. System memory amounts to 2304.0 GB of RAM, offering a high memory-to-core allocation of 9.0 GB per vCPU to maintain data feeds for massive processing pipelines.

For hardware acceleration, the instance integrates 8 NVIDIA Blackwell architecture GPUs delivering a combined 384 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities feature an extensive 380 Gbps baseline bandwidth, ensuring sufficient network throughput for high-throughput cluster synchronization and distributed deep learning communication. The instance does not bundle local storage, meaning external block storage volumes or networked file systems are required to persist data.

From a resource utilization perspective, the platform emphasizes concentrated GPU acceleration backed by extensive host memory and high-capacity network fabric. The absence of local disk drives trade off local storage IOPS for network-attached storage architectures, necessitating properly provisioned remote storage pipelines. The server is suited for large-scale distributed artificial intelligence training, high-throughput LLM fine-tuning, complex neural network inference, and data-intensive scientific computing.
